summary: A mild equity rally kicked off August after Trump called off an attack on Iran, easing geopolitical risk — though markets remain skeptical as Iran denied being in talks. That relief is competing with a soft labor market backdrop: the June jobs report showed only 57,000 nonfarm payrolls added, roughly half the median economist forecast.
tweet: Iran war fears dialed back and a deeply soft June jobs print are driving this week's cross-asset moves — stocks up, bonds selling off, gold losing its safe-haven bid.
